# Capri DMC
> Capri Destination Management Company is an elite Business-to-Business (B2B) luxury destination management company curated by Team Nesea on the island of Capri, Italy. Capri DMC serves luxury travel advisors, boutique agencies, corporate planners, and discerning private clients.

## Company Identity & Lineage
- Entity: Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC)
- Heritage: Curated by Team Nesea (hospitality leadership on Capri since 2010)
- Corporate Structure: 100% Women-Owned Business
- Founders: Giusy Perrotta (Director of Operations), Melania Esposito (Head of Event Production), Roberta De Martino (Lead Cultural Curator)
- Operations: On-ground island dispatch, resident presence, and white-label representation
- Slogan: "Proudly Owned by Caprese People"
- Headquarters: 80076 Capri, Metropolitan City of Naples, Campania, Italy
- Coordinates: 40.5507° N, 14.2426° E
- Direct Advisor Phone / WhatsApp: +39 333 594 3947
- Direct WhatsApp Chat: https://wa.me/393335943947
- Primary Email: partnerships@capridmc.com
- Official Website: https://www.capridmc.com/
- Appointment Booking: https://www.capridmc.com/contact-us-capri-destination-management-company/

## Exclusive Solutions (Maritime & Strategic Logistics)
- [Exclusive Guided Island Tours](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Privileged Cultural Access Led by Certified Native Capresi Guides. Crafted exclusively for discerning travelers, our private guided walking and cultural tours reveal the authentic soul of Capri and Anacapri. Led by certified resident art historians and native guides from Team Nesea, guests discover hidden courtyards, Roman imperial villas (Villa Jovis, Villa Damecuta), and private botanical terraces with uncompromised local depth.
- [Capri Private Boat Services & Gozzo Charters](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Traditional Gozzo Caprese, Speedboats & Luxury Yacht Charters. Through our trusted on-island maritime network, Capri DMC offers luxury travel advisors access to Capri's traditional wooden gozzo boats, speedboats, and private yacht charters. Our licensed native skippers navigate coastal waters and scenic coves, complemented by chilled champagne and tailored luxury catering onboard.
- [Private and Exclusive Transfer Services](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Naples-to-Capri Chauffeured Logistics & Island Luggage Coordination. From arrival at Naples Capodichino (NAP) airport or rail hub, Capri DMC coordinates private transfers with luxury chauffeured cars or vans (NCC) and maritime crossings. Upon arrival on the island, iconic open-top convertible taxis are arranged on request through our trusted network, with dedicated luggage transport coordinated to deliver bags safely to private villas or hotel rooms following guest arrival.
- [White-Label On-Island Service](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Discreet Ground Representation Elevating Your Brand Reputation. We act as your professional, discreet on-island extension in Capri, operating under strict white-label protocols to protect and elevate your agency's reputation. Because our team lives on Capri year-round, we ensure constant presence and exceptional resilience during adverse weather events or unexpected schedule changes: we live here, ensuring immediate, reliable ground coordination.

## Custom Experiences (Heritage, Gastronomy & Island Lifestyle)
- [Weddings, Bar Mitzvahs & Milestone Celebrations](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Historic Villa Buyouts, Scenic Jewish Lifecycle Events & Gala Production. Capri DMC orchestrates high-end island celebrations with profound local heritage. We manage private historic cliffside villa buyouts, luxury wedding ceremonies, and specialized Jewish celebrations (Bar Mitzvah, Bat Mitzvah, Kiddushin) featuring scenic Torah readings overlooking the Mediterranean, Shabbat logistics, and strictly supervised Kosher catering coordination.
- [Artisanal Sandals, Knitwear & Bespoke Textiles](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Made in Capri: Master Craftsmen & Heritage Ateliers. Immerse your clients in Capri's legendary tradition of sartorial excellence. We arrange private atelier visits with master Caprese cordwainers for custom-measured handmade leather sandals, tailored while guests sip prosecco, as well as private commissions for bespoke cashmere knitwear, hand-woven linens, and island silk scarves.
- [Private Cooking Classes in Authentic Caprese Homes](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Cook Like a Local with Resident Culinary Masters. A rare invitation into authentic Caprese homes and panoramic private estate gardens. Guided by native home cooks and sommeliers, your guests learn the secrets of traditional Ravioli Capresi, fresh handmade pasta, sea bass al cartoccio, Caprese chocolate cake, and authentic Limoncello crafted from freshly harvested organic island lemons.
- [Personal Shopper Service & Global Shipping](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Via Camerelle Luxury Ateliers to Secure Worldwide Freight. An insider shopping experience spanning the stylish streets of Capri and Anacapri. From reserved appointments at premier ateliers along Via Camerelle to hidden artisan perfumeries, our personal shoppers curate bespoke wardrobes and oversee international tax-free documentation and insured door-to-door freight shipping.
- [Hidden Hiking Excursions & Secret Nature Routes](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Pristine Trails Far Removed from Mass Commercial Footfall. For clients seeking nature and rejuvenation, Capri DMC leads guided expeditions along the island's secret, breathtaking cliffside paths. From the dramatic Sentiero dei Fortini coastal trail to Mount Solaro ridges, ancient hermitages, and secret sea lookouts, our naturalist guides provide an exclusive encounter with Capri's raw Mediterranean wilderness.
- [Personal Trainer & Private Sport Activities](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): In-Villa Fitness, Panoramic Cliff Yoga & Marine Sports. Ensuring high-end guests sustain their fitness and wellness regimens during their stay. We dispatch certified personal trainers directly to private villas or hotel terraces for sunrise yoga overlooking the Faraglioni, private Pilates, tennis coaching, and guided sea kayaking or paddle-boarding into emerald sea caves.
- [Bespoke Babysitting & Pet Sitting for B2B Clients](https://www.capridmc.com/#services): Vetted, Trustworthy Care Giving VIP Clients Complete Freedom. High-net-worth clients often require trusted support to attend private yacht charters, romantic sunset dinners, or late-night celebrations. Capri DMC provides thoroughly vetted, multilingual babysitters and professional pet-sitters across the entire island, ensuring absolute safety, attentive engagement, and complete peace of mind.

## Key Geographic Entities & Coverage
- [Capri Center & Piazzetta](https://www.capridmc.com/): Via Camerelle luxury district, historic courtyards, boutique hotels, and luxury private villas.
- [Faraglioni di Capri & Marina Piccola](https://www.capridmc.com/): Dawn protocol at the Faraglioni, secluded swimming coves, and private beach clubs.
- [Anacapri & Mount Solaro](https://www.capridmc.com/): Damecuta imperial villa, Monte Solaro chairlift, Punta Carena lighthouse, cliffside estates.
- [Amalfi Coast & Gulf of Naples Connections](https://www.capridmc.com/): Direct chartered speedboat crossings and transfers between Capri, Positano, Amalfi, Ravello, Nerano, and Naples (NAP).

## B2B Travel Advisor Advantages
- Protected Commissions: Strict transparent net pricing preserving travel designer margins.
- White-Label Service: On request, all personnel operate discreetly under your agency's branding, protecting and elevating your reputation.
- On-Ground Dispatch & Weather Resilience: Real-time on-island coordination and resilience during adverse maritime conditions: we live here.
- Authentic Local Fleet: Speedboats and traditional Gozzo Caprese with luxury catering and chilled champagne onboard.
